title: 8 NV2A polygon offset / depth bias combinations
purpose: Render an 8-cell 4x2 grid isolating the NV2A polygon-offset / depth-bias path (NV097_SET_POLY_OFFSET_FILL_ENABLE 0x0338 + NV097_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET_SCALE_FACTOR 0x0384 -> NV_PGRAPH_ZOFFSETFACTOR + NV097_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET_BIAS 0x0388 -> NV_PGRAPH_ZOFFSETBIAS). Per cell: a polygon-offset-OFF GREEN base quad is drawn at clip z=0.5, then a RED quad (same plane) with the cell's polygon-offset config, under LEQUAL depth test. RED survives only when its biased depth wins LEQUAL; otherwise GREEN shows through. In this fork (PR #2240 / XEMU_NATIVE_TRI_DEPTH) polygon offset is applied in the FRAGMENT SHADER (shared glsl/psh.c: zvalue += depthOffset; zvalue += depthFactor*nativeTriMZ), NOT via glPolygonOffset/setDepthBias; Metal consumes the same generated GLSL, so GL and Metal MUST agree. clipRange.y = 16777215 for the pbkit default fixed-point Z24S8 zeta, so units (depthOffset) is added in window-depth units. Cells: (0) offset OFF -> RED tie; (1) ON units=factor=0 -> RED tie; (2) ON +100000 units -> GREEN; (3) ON -100000 units -> RED; (4) ON +8000000 units -> GREEN; (5) ON -8000000 units -> RED; (6) ON +10 factor on a sloped quad -> GREEN; (7) ON -10 factor on a sloped quad -> RED. Cells 0/1 are the offset-machinery-off and zero-magnitude controls; 2-5 sweep the units (bias) sign and magnitude; 6-7 exercise the factor (slope) term and its sign. Blend/stencil/cull OFF; depth test + polygon offset are the only variables; saturated 0/255 endpoints for byte-exact cross-renderer compare. POINT/LINE offset enables and the w-buffer (z_perspective) factor path are second-wave follow-ups.
